title.zh: 细胞 · 生命的最小单位间

description.zh: 细胞是生命的最小单位间：一层膜划出内外，细胞核指挥，线粒体供能，叶绿体（植物）光合，液泡储物。植物细胞比动物细胞多一面墙（细胞壁）和一个大水囊。
description.en: The cell is life's smallest workshop: a membrane draws inside from outside, the nucleus commands, mitochondria supply energy, chloroplasts (plants) photosynthesize, vacuoles store. Plant cells add a wall and a large water sac over animal cells.

label.zh: 叶绿体是光合作用的车间

reason.zh: 细胞页里叶绿体只是“光合的工位”，光合页讲它怎样把光变成糖——结构与功能在两页接上，植物细胞多出叶绿体正为此准备。
reason.en: On the cell page the chloroplast is just 'the photosynthesis workstation'; the photosynthesis page shows how it turns light into sugar — structure meets function across the two pages, and plant cells carry chloroplasts for exactly this.

label.zh: 细胞是分子搭成的车间
label.en: Cells are workshops built from molecules

reason.zh: 从叶子逐级放大到细胞，是同一条尺度链的下一级：细胞比分子大得多，里面的工位全由分子搭成。
reason.en: Zooming from a leaf down to a cell is the next level of the same scale chain: cells are far larger than molecules, and every workstation inside is built from them.

label.zh: 核里的信息要靠复制传下去
label.en: The nucleus's information passes on through replication

reason.zh: 细胞核管着遗传信息，信息要进下一代就得复制——细胞页的“指挥中心”，在复制页变成“复制什么、怎么保真”。
reason.en: The nucleus holds the genetic information, and for it to reach the next generation it must be copied — the cell page's 'command center' becomes, on the replication page, 'what is copied and how faithfully'.
